summaryZh: Aceves 实验室研究嗜酸性粒细胞性食管炎（EoE）中组织重塑的机制、介质和临床影响，关注上皮细胞、成纤维细胞和平滑肌的变化。实验室使用原代人食管细胞和组织作为体外模型，并开展临床与转化研究。
researchQuestions: 除已知因素外，还有哪些细胞因子参与嗜酸性粒细胞性食管炎的发病过程？
哪些机制驱动嗜酸性粒细胞性食管炎中的上皮、成纤维细胞和平滑肌变化？
topics: 嗜酸性粒细胞性食管炎
methods: 原代人食管细胞与组织体外模型

evidence.quote: The Aceves lab conducts clinical and translational investigations of the impact and mechanisms of tissue remodeling on eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE).
The Aceves Lab uses primary human esophageal cells and tissue as in vitro model systems to understand the mechanisms driving epithelial, fibroblast and smooth muscle changes in EoE.
Seema Aceves, MD, PhD, is a Professor of Pediatrics and Medicine at UC San Diego
Cytokines produced by T-helper type 2 cells and transforming growth factor beta 1 (TGFβ1) contribute to the development of EoE, but other cytokines involved in pathogenesis are unknown.
The Aceves Lab uses primary human esophageal cells and tissue as in vitro model systems to understand the mechanisms driving epithelial, fibroblast and smooth muscle changes in EoE.
